newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U hopeful for work on diabetes drug.
newsitem.headline: P&U hopeful for work on diabetes drug.

text.p: The head of Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn's Swedish research division said on Wednesday the company had big hopes for its research on an anti-diabetes drug.

"It's very exciting and hopeful. The market is completely enormous and tests look promising. With the techniques that are available now we understand why the substance has the effect that it does," company spokesman Les Hudson told Reuters.
"It allows us to be more exact in our research."
Hudson said the research indicates it is possible to cure diabetes and diabetes related to being overweight but added that studies were in very early stages.
"People should remember that no development studies have yet started so it means five years before any possible drug can become a reality," he said.
